_readme: AUTHORED. Which halls an automatic layout pass may touch, and which bodies inside them it may not.
Keyed 'chapter|pearl', the same key ada_run/em_layout_walk.json uses.
mode: 'manual'  measured and reported, NEVER moved. This is the default, and it is also
the default for any hall not listed here at all. Locking is the resting
state: a pass can only ever touch halls someone opted in by hand.
mode: 'auto'    a pass may move this hall's bodies.
pinned: [...]   tokens inside an auto hall that you placed yourself. They stay put even
while the rest of the hall is automatic.
note:           why. Write one for every hall you unlock, and for every pin.
Locking hides nothing. Every hall is scored and drawn whatever its mode; the mode governs
what may be CHANGED, never what may be SEEN. Read the score with:
Nothing is unlocked yet. Palle (2026-09-19): 'I still want to be able to edit the positions.
